secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: HS256 signing secret for session cookies (jose). Generated dev placeholder; replace for production.

secrets.name: OAUTH_SERVER_URL
secrets.description: Manus OAuth server base URL. Required for login flow. Optional for boot (landing page renders without it).

secrets.name: VITE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Manus project/app ID used by OAuth token exchange and session tokens. Required for login.

secrets.name: OWNER_OPEN_ID
secrets.description: Manus openId of the project owner; auto-promoted to admin role on login. Optional for boot.

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_URL
secrets.description: Manus Forge API base URL. Powers LLM, image generation, storage proxy, and heartbeat cron jobs. Optional for boot.

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Manus Forge API bearer key. Required alongside BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_URL for forge features. Optional for boot.
